summary: US airstrikes on Iran drew UN war crimes allegations with 178+ civilians killed, including 120 children at a Minab school. IDF eliminated two Hamas Nukhba commanders in northern Gaza and struck southern Lebanon. Russia and China vetoed UN sanctions extension on Iran as Trump nears a decision on resuming large-scale military operations.
key_points: IDF killed Hamas Nukhba commanders Shreef Shadi Ibrahim Labad and Yosef Saad Al-Eddin Radha in northern Gaza Strip using precision munitions (Source: @New_security8200/203819).
UN fact-finding mission accused US of war crimes in two airstrikes killing at least 178 civilians including ~120 children at Minab school and 22 at Lamard (Source: @VahidOnline/78419).
Russia and China vetoed US draft UN Security Council resolution to extend Iran sanctions committee 1737; 11 voted yes, Pakistan and Somalia abstained (Source: @VahidOnline/78418).
Israeli jets struck Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Bani Haiyan in southern Lebanon; artillery shelling reported at Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Mifdun, and Mansouri (Source: @presstv/207170, @redlinkleb/43584).
IRGC targeted oil tanker Trend in Hormuz Strait; UKMTO reported security incident 16nm NE of Khor Al Adaid, Oman (Source: @VahidOnline/78425, @VahidOnline/78424).
US Treasury sanctioned Bitcoin bank Babak Zanjani, channeling hundreds of millions to IRGC via Hormuz network (Source: @mamlekate/104526).
Trump told Axios he nears a big decision on resuming large-scale Iran war operations ahead of Gulf leaders meeting at UN GA (Source: @VahidOnline/78423).

sections.executive_summary: US airstrikes on Iran drew UN war crimes allegations with 178+ civilians killed, including 120 children at a Minab school. IDF eliminated two Hamas Nukhba commanders in northern Gaza and struck southern Lebanon. Russia and China vetoed UN sanctions extension on Iran as Trump nears a decision on resuming large-scale military operations.

iran.text: UN Independent Fact-Finding Mission found reasonable grounds that US committed war crimes in two airstrikes on Iran on 9 Esfand 1404, killing at least 178 civilians including women and children; Tomahawks hit Shajra Tayyeba elementary school in Minab killing 150+ including ~120 children, and tungsten flechettes struck a sports complex and residential area in Lamard killing 22 civilians (Source: @VahidOnline/78419).

Russia and China vetoed US draft UN Security Council resolution to extend sanctions committee 1737 against Iran; 11 members voted yes, Pakistan and Somalia abstained; Moscow and Beijing argue 2231 JCPOA sanctions expired October 2025 (Source: @VahidOnline/78418).

US Treasury sanctioned Bitcoin bank Babak Zanjani (Bitbank) as part of Iran sanctions evasion network, channeling hundreds of millions of dollars to IRGC, linked to Hormuz Strait operations (Source: @mamlekate/104526).

Trump told Axios he is near a crossroads on Iran war, deciding whether to resume large-scale operations to destroy the regime; US maintaining force levels in Middle East through year-end; direct Iran-US contact ongoing (Source: @VahidOnline/78423).

US approved Iranian delegation attendance at UN General Assembly in NYC next week with travel restrictions and luxury goods purchase ban; delegation smaller than previous year (Source: @pkpoi/143974).

Maritime blockade of Iran effective: no ship has reached Iran since blockade began; US increased tanker and gas carrier transits through Hormuz Strait; oil prices remain elevated (Source: @VahidOnline/78423).

israel.text: IDF killed Hamas Nukhba military wing militants Shreef Shadi Ibrahim Labad at Shalosh (G) and commander Yosef Saad Al-Eddin Radha at Shalosh (B) in northern Gaza Strip; precision munitions and aerial surveillance used, civilian harm mitigation steps taken (Source: @New_security8200/203819).
IDF launched interceptor at suspected hostile aircraft in Manara/Margaliot area; initial assessment suggests false alarm, investigation ongoing (Source: @New_security8200/203828).
Israeli fighter jets carried out airstrikes on Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Bani Haiyan in southern Lebanon (Source: @presstv/207170).
Israeli occupation court extended detention of Press TV journalist Naqaa Hamed until September 23, 2026, in West Bank (Source: @presstv/207185).
IDF UAV crashed into sea near Palmachim due to technical malfunction; Navy recovered asset, no data leak feared, investigation ongoing (Source: @idf_telegram/25153).
Sensitive security investigation entered new phase at MEHAAM, details under gag order (Source: @pkpoi/143972).

gaza_west_bank.text: IDF eliminated Hamas Nukhba commander Shreef Shadi Ibrahim Labad at Shalosh in northern Gaza Strip, participant in Kerem Shalom crossing massacre on October 7 (Source: @inon_yttach/10036, @New_security8200/203819).

IDF eliminated Nukhba military wing commander Yosef Saad Al-Eddin Radha in earlier northern Gaza strike this week; militants were rebuilding Hamas capabilities in violation of ceasefire (Source: @New_security8200/203819).
Israeli occupation court extended Press TV journalist Naqaa Hamed detention until September 23, 2026, in occupied West Bank (Source: @presstv/207185).
IDF Southern Command forces deployed in Gaza in accordance with ceasefire agreement, continuing threat removal operations (Source: @New_security8200/203819).

Trump to meet six Gulf leaders—Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman—at UN GA in NYC to discuss next steps in Iran war (Source: @VahidOnline/78423).
Houthi leader Abdul-Malik Al-Houthi claims Saudi regime shares intelligence with Israel and participated in US aggression against Yemen (Source: @presstv/207169).

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict is expanding across multiple fronts with US airstrikes on Iran prompting war crimes allegations, Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon continuing, and Houthi involvement in Yemen escalating regional tensions. Trump's proximity to a decision on resuming large-scale Iran operations introduces a high-risk threshold; Gulf state coordination at the UN GA could shape whether diplomacy or escalation dominates the coming phase. The Hormuz Strait remains a flashpoint with IRGC targeting of vessels and UKMTO security incidents compounding maritime instability.
sections.regional_response: Six Gulf states—Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, and Oman—are being consulted by Trump on next steps, indicating Washington seeks regional backing before any major escalation. Saudi Arabia and Qatar previously warned against retaliatory Iranian strikes on their oil facilities, and the F-35 sale to Riyadh signals deepening US military integration. Houthi claims of Saudi-Israeli intelligence coordination add a layer of proxy friction that could destabilize Yemen and the Red Sea corridor.
sections.intelligence_notes: The UN veto by Russia and China removes the last multilateral sanctions mechanism on Iran, potentially emboldening Tehran's nuclear posture. The IRGC's maritime operations in Hormuz and the sanctioned cryptocurrency network illustrate adaptive sanctions evasion. The MEHAAM investigation entering a new phase under gag order suggests an undisclosed Israeli security matter of potential operational significance. Multiple artillery and airstrike reports from southern Lebanon indicate sustained cross-border hostilities that could trigger broader confrontation.
